normal_units.Name: Miner
normal_units.Description: A Heavy, Economy Unit of the Order Empire. Gathers Gold and Crystal from resource nodes with each swing of its pickaxe.

normal_units.Name: Enslaved Miner
normal_units.Description: A Light, Economy Unit of the Chaos Empire. Gathers Gold and Crystal from resource nodes with each swing of its pickaxe.

normal_units.Name: Swordwrath
normal_units.Description: A low Health, Light, Melee Unit of the Order Empire. Wields a massive sword to engage in close combat.

Abilities.Name: Leap
Abilities.Description: Leaps forward and stuns the first enemy that it hits.

normal_units.Name: Sicklewrath
normal_units.Description: A low Health, Light, Melee Unit of the Order Empire. Uses its Sickle to cause splash area of effect.

normal_units.Name: Archidon
normal_units.Description: A low Health, Light, Ranged Unit of the Order Empire. Wields a large bow to strike down foes from a distance.

normal_units.Name: Spearton
normal_units.Description: A high Health, Heavy, Melee Unit of the Order that wields a powerful spear and sturdy shield.

Abilities.Name: Block
Abilities.Description: Reduces incoming damage by a fixed amount per hit but lowers attack speed.

normal_units.Name: Juggerknight
normal_units.Description: A high Health, Heavy, Melee Unit of the Chaos Empire that wields an axe and shield.

Abilities.Name: Charge
Abilities.Description: Charges forward, dealing massive damage to the first enemy hit.

normal_units.Name: Dead
normal_units.Description: A low Health, Light, Melee Unit of the Chaos Empire. A reanimated corpse that attacks with its claws.

normal_units.Name: Toxic Dead
normal_units.Description: A medium Health, Heavy, Ranged Unit of the Chaos Empire. Throws toxic projectiles that deal poison damage over time to enemies.

normal_units.Name: Bomber
normal_units.Description: Chaos assasination unit that deliver a devastating explosion on contact with the enemy

Abilities.Name: Self-Destruct
Abilities.Description: The Bomber explodes, dealing massive area of effect damage to nearby enemies but killing itself in the process.

normal_units.Name: Eclipsor
normal_units.Description: A low Health, Light, Flying, Ranged Unit of the Chaos Empire. Wields a large bow to strike down foes from the air. Powerful against Light Units.

normal_units.Name: Shadowrath
normal_units.Description: A medium Health, Light, Melee Unit of the Order Empire. Uses speed and agility to kill foes. Powerful against Light Units.

Abilities.Name: Parry
Abilities.Description: Blocks incoming damage effects such as stun.

Passive.Name: Fixate
Passive.Description: Consecutive attacks against the same target increase damage by 5, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.

normal_units.Name: Riprider
normal_units.Damage: 13 | 20 vs Heavy Units (Maximum 2 enemies got 20% damage)
normal_units.Description: Mounted fighter. Splash 20% damage to enemies in area.

normal_units.Name: Magikill
normal_units.Description: A low Health, Light, Magic Unit of the Order Empire. Uses spellcasting to create powerful area of effect spells and summon minions.

Abilities.Name: Summon Minions
Abilities.Description: Summons a magical Melee minion. (Maximum 2 minions with Temple II)

Abilities.Name: Fulminate
Abilities.Description: A powerful area of effect explosion that damages and stuns enemies in the area.

normal_units.Name: Meric
normal_units.Description: A low Health, Light, Magic Unit of the Order Empire. Uses spellcasting to healing allies.

Abilities.Name: Heal
Abilities.Description: Restores health to a targeted allied unit.

Abilities.Name: Shield
Abilities.Description: Creates a protective barrier around Meric that blocks all projectiles. (Requires Temple I)

normal_units.Name: Giant
normal_units.Queue Type: Heavy | Giant with Monostrosity & Armory II
normal_units.Damage: 35 | 60 vs Heavy Units (Maximum 2 enemies got 90% damage)
normal_units.Description: A very high Health, Giant Unit of the Chaos Empire.

Abilities.Name: Earthquake
Abilities.Description: Slam the ground with a massive leg, sending out a directional shockware.

normal_units.Name: Endslaved Giant
normal_units.Queue Type: Heavy | Giant with Monostrosity & Armory II
normal_units.Description: A very high Health, Giant Unit of the Order Empire.

Abilities.Name: Catapult
Abilities.Description: With feet planted in the ground, the giant has 25% extra range, 17% extra damage and 10% extra splash damage. (Requires Forge I)

normal_units.Name: Crawler
normal_units.Description: A very low Health, Light Unit of the Chaos Empire.
